title: Why the old executor cannot start new runs
md:
The api used to write a run row and let executors **poll** for it. Since the push-based start, the api hands each run to one executor directly.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  api[api] -- push start --> new[new executor]
  api -. no push handler .-> old[old executor]
```

An executor built before the change never receives a start, so its runs wait forever.
